public static final class Common.KinematicModel extends com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessageLite<Common.KinematicModel,Common.KinematicModel.Builder> implements Common.KinematicModelOrBuilder
 KinematicModel describes a component's kinematics as a tree of links and joints.
 Its proto JSON encoding is also the on-disk kinematics file format.
